subject: Vulnerability report: cross-workspace read on GET /v2/apps/{id}
body:
Hello security team,

I'm reporting an issue I found while testing with my own free workspaces. GET /v2/apps/{app_id} returns the full app record (including environment variable names and the owner email) for app IDs that belong to a different workspace, as long as the request carries any valid key.

I confirmed it only between two test workspaces I own (ws_q7m2ka and ws_r4t9bn): a key scoped to ws_q7m2ka can read apps in ws_r4t9bn. I have not tried to access anyone else's data and won't. Happy to share the full write-up privately, just tell me where to send it.

attachment.content:
GET /v2/apps/app_r4t9bn01 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.vantimere.example
Authorization: Bearer mk_live_****a71c   (key belongs to ws_q7m2ka)

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Request-Id: req_4c1e9a7b20
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":"app_r4t9bn01","workspace_id":"ws_r4t9bn","owner_email":"researcher.b@example.com","env_keys":["DATABASE_URL","STRIPE_KEY"]}
